 tat-tac-
779chāstra-anumāna-ācārya-upadeśair avagatam artha-tattvaṃ sad-
bhūtam
780 eva bhavaty eteṣāṃ
781 yathā-bhūta-artha-pratipādana-sāmarthyāt, tathā–api yāvad
ekadeśo'pi kaś cin na sva-karaṇa-saṃvedyo bhavati tāvat sarvaṃ paro'kṣam iva–apavarga-
ādiṣu
782 sūkṣmeṣv artheṣu na dṛḍhāṃ buddhim utpādayati / Tasmāc chāstra-anumāna-ācārya-
upadeśa-upodbalana-artham eva
783–avaśyaṃ kaś cid artha
784-viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣī-kartavyaḥ, tatra
tad-upadiṣṭa-artha-ekadeśa-pratyakṣatve sati sarvaṃ sūkṣma-viṣayam apy ā–apavargāc
chraddhīyate / Etad artham eva–idaṃ citta-parikarma nirdiśyate / Aniyatāsu vṛttiṣu tad-
viṣayāyāṃ vaśīkāra-saṃjñāyām upajātāy
